data.one_liner: Performs polygon clipping, intersection, union, difference, XOR, and offsetting operations.
data.what_it_does: The clipper2 library performs intersection, union, difference and xor boolean operations on both simple and complex polygons. It also performs polygon offsetting. This library is a Dart port of Angus Johnson's Clipper2 library.
use_when: You need to perform boolean operations (intersection, union, difference, XOR) on polygons
You need polygon offsetting capabilities in a Dart or Flutter application
avoid_when: You need high precision 64-bit integer operations on the web (precision is restricted)
You are looking for UI widgets or full UI kits
strengths: Port of the well-tested and robust Clipper2 library
Works across all platforms including mobile, desktop, and web
Provides extensive HTML documentation from the original C++ library
weaknesses: Precision is restricted when compiling for the web due to lack of 64-bit integers
